## Recommendations

1. **Request indexing for all 5 deployed Spanish pages.** Submit each URL in Google Search Console's URL inspection tool. These pages exist on the live site but Google hasn't crawled them yet. Priority: `/es/administracion-renta-vacacional-toluca/` (geo page with target keywords).

2. **Deploy the 3 remaining geo pages** (malinalco, metepec, valle-de-bravo) to `public/` and add them to the sitemap. Content is written but not live.

3. **Focus content improvement on /vacation-rental-management-software/.** This page has 1,572 impressions but 0 clicks at position ~60. The keyword "vacation rental management software" alone has 888 impressions. Strengthen the page with better H1/H2 targeting, add comparison tables, and build internal links to it. Even moving to page 3-4 (position 21-40) would start generating clicks.

4. **Add structured data (FAQ, HowTo) to /vacation-rental-website-builder/.** The long-tail "wix vs squarespace vs lodgify vs hostaway" is already at position 7.1 — add a dedicated comparison section to capture that traffic. 549 total impressions suggests strong keyword space.

5. **Build internal links from homepage → English blog posts.** The homepage gets 108 impressions and 5 clicks. Link equity from it should flow to the high-impression blog posts that are stuck on pages 5-7.
